title: Whose Boat Does it Float? Improving Personalization in Preference Tuning via Inferred User Personas
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component of evaluating ethics and morals by using the BeaverTails dataset (which benchmarks harm categories including unethical behavior) to infer personas and evaluate tailored responses. It also utilizes 'abductive moral reasoning' as a framework for its Persona Inference (PI) task and conducts human evaluations specifically on the 'Harmfulness' of generated personas.
